test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is '**occur**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses how heavy downpours take place during the wet season.
 
• The verb should correctly indicate an event that happens naturally in a specific season.
 
• "**Occur**" is the best fit as it means something takes place or happens, which aligns with the context of rainfall in the savanna.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Pass" does not fit as it implies movement rather than an event happening.
 
• "Materialise" means to become real or visible, which does not match the natural occurrence of rain.
 
• "Conquer" means to take control, which is incorrect in this context.
